title: Barnaby Bear's Lost Button
description: A gentle story about a soft bear who loses a button, only to find a delightful new friend using it.

scenes.narration: Deep in the green woods, Barnaby Bear loved his cozy red sweater more than anything else in the world.
scenes.visual: cute fluffy brown bear wearing a bright red knitted sweater standing in a sunny mossy forest

scenes.narration: But one chilly afternoon, Barnaby looked down and noticed something awful. A shiny wooden button was missing!
scenes.visual: close up of fluffy bear looking surprised at a loose thread on his sweater

scenes.narration: He retraced his steps along the forest path, searching carefully under bright autumn leaves and soft green moss.
scenes.visual: little bear bending down examining golden leaves on a dirt path in the woods

scenes.narration: Near the hollow oak tree, he spotted a tiny mouse family sitting around his wooden button, eating berries.
scenes.visual: tiny mice sitting around a smooth wooden button used as a small dining table

scenes.narration: Barnaby smiled softly. The button made a perfect little table for them, and they looked so full of joy.
scenes.visual: friendly bear smiling warmly down at tiny mice in a cozy hollow tree stump

scenes.narration: He decided to gift the button to his new friends and tied his sweater thread into a neat bow.
scenes.visual: bear tying a tiny bow on his sweater thread while mice wave happily

scenes.narration: Warm hearts make the cozy feelings last forever. Sleep tight, and follow along for more sweet bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: bear sleeping peacefully in a warm bedroom with glowing cozy lantern light
